svg.title: Reconstructed multi-panel guidance and downsample matrix figure
svg.desc: Four main base frames: an irregular high/low resolution space diagram at upper left, a rounded comparison panel at lower left, a rounded downsample matrix selection panel at upper right, and a rounded commutator-zero guidance panel at lower right. Contents include axes, points, arrows, matrix cubes, formula boxes, stylized generated-image thumbnails, status marks, and mathematical annotations.

polygon.desc: Upper-left irregular high-resolution and low-resolution space frame with slanted plane, coordinate axes, down arrow, trajectories, guidance arrows, and target space blob.

rect.desc: Lower-left comparison frame containing prompt text and three stylized thumbnail images labeled Full resolution, Naïve, and Ours, with resolution and DreamSim annotations plus red cross and green check marks.
Upper-right downsample matrix selection frame with title, high-resolution tensor cube, several candidate downsample matrix cubes, lower vectorized products, ellipses, and argmin formula.
Lower-right commutator-zero guidance frame with title, blue sample points, black and dashed purple vector fields, red discrepancy vectors, and formula in rounded rectangle.

g.title: High-res and low-res space conduction diagram
